_comment: Copy to config.json and fill in. JSON has no comments — see README for each field. config.json is gitignored; this example is committed. All values are Discord snowflakes (enable Developer Mode, right-click to copy ids).
_operatorChannelId_comment: LOOKUP KEY ONLY for the DM kill switch: the operator channel (#qofi-product) id, used solely to read groups[<id>].allowFrom from access.json for authorization. The watcher does NOT bind to, post in, or surface in this channel. Omit → kill switch authorizes no one (fail-closed).
_liveness_comment: AUTO-mode liveness monitor (everything-in-bus: state parsed from the bus, pings posted to the bus). livenessEnabled=false keeps it OFF; the relay runs normally. Thresholds are seconds; defaults shown (silence/cooldown 30m, check 60s) and may be omitted.
_usage_limit_comment: Usage-limit overlay (RATE_LIMITED). The watcher reads swarm-watch's status.json (default ~/.config/swarm/status.json; override with env CTO_WATCHER_SWARM_STATUS_JSON, or point SWARM_STATE_DIR at the dir) to learn which CTOs are paused on a Claude usage/5-hour limit, so it stops pinging a capped loop and waits. resumeBufferSeconds = grace window after a cap lifts before a resume nudge fires (lets Claude Code auto-resume first). swarmStatusMaxAgeSeconds = how stale the feed may be before it's distrusted. Defaults shown; may be omitted.
_attachments_comment: Attachment shuttling. The watcher REPOSTS messages (not Discord's native forward), so it downloads any .md/.txt attachment from its CDN url and re-uploads it on the reposted message — both directions. Other file types are ignored. maxAttachmentBytes caps a single file's re-upload (default 8388608 = 8 MiB, conservatively under every boost tier); a bigger file is noted '[watcher: could not relay attached <name>]' instead of carried. attachmentDownloadTimeoutSeconds bounds the CDN fetch (default 15). Both may be omitted.
_ctoChannels_comment: Per CTO: channelId (where it lives), botUserId (mentioned on delivery so its swarm acts). botUserId ALSO serves as the inbound author allowlist (A1): only messages authored by it are shuttled CTO->bus — operator forwards / other bots are ignored. Override with an explicit authorId only if the CTO posts under a different id than it's mentioned at (normally it doesn't). A channel with neither authorId nor botUserId will NOT shuttle (fail-closed + startup warning).
